'''Windredd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a loyal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Renata Alde]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While protecting Renata, he engaged a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] and was quickly defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Windredd is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games|massively multi-player online role playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Brian Bloom]].
